questions.text: A launch that stops early leaves no new reflection, but the previous launch's .scratch file can still be there; how does the orchestrator avoid appending it twice?

options.A: append nothing when the file's heading (role and time) is already in the issue's reflection file; nobody deletes the .scratch file
options.B: the orchestrator deletes the .scratch file after appending it
options.C: say nothing; rely on the orchestrator noticing

rollback: remove the clause 'or one whose heading the file already holds' from the Reading a return paragraph of agent-kit/process.md and the matching sentence in the Reflection section of agent-kit/procedures/formats.md

questions.text: tests/test_claims.py requires a blueprints.md row for every loose template, and agent-kit/blueprints.md is not on the Files line; may the new templates/reflection.md get a row there?

options.A: add a 'Reflection files' row after the 'Session summaries folder' row, and add blueprints.md with its word change to the CHANGELOG entry
options.B: append templates/reflection.md to the last cell of the 'Session summaries folder' row instead
options.C: leave blueprints.md alone; make verify stays red on test_claims
